```{r restore environment, eval=TRUE}
Sys.getenv("OPENGWAS_JWT") != ""
ieugwasr::user()
Sys.setenv(LD_LIBRARY_PATH = "")

setwd("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/project") #main working directory where my renv lives

```

```{r libraries and directories}
filepath <- "/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/project"

outPath <- file.path(filepath, "data", "processed")

print(outPath)

# Load libraries (should be installed in the renv)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(TwoSampleMR)

```

# Endo and PTU
```{r reloading RDs}
endo_qc <- readRDS(paste0(outPath, "/endo_qc.RData"))
tobacco_qc <- readRDS(paste0(outPath, "/tobacco_qc.RData"))
```

### Mendelian Randomization (Endo and PTU)
- between Endometriosis and Problematic Tobacco Use


```{r harmonization and preprocessing}

tobacco_clump <- tobacco_qc
tobacco_clump$SNP <- tobacco_clump$rsID

endo_clump <- endo_qc
endo_clump$SNP <- endo_clump$rsID

source(paste0(filepath, "/scripts/mr_preprocessing.R"))

#endo to tobacco
endo_to_tobacco <- harmonize_mr(
  exposure_dat = endo_clump,
  outcome_dat = tobacco_clump,
  exposure_name = "endometriosis",
  outcome_name = "tobacco use",
  p_threshold = 5e-8
)

table(endo_to_tobacco$mr_keep) 
attr(endo_to_tobacco, "log")

#tobacco to endo
tobacco_to_endo <- harmonize_mr(
  exposure_dat = tobacco_clump,
  outcome_dat = endo_clump,
  exposure_name = "tobacco use",
  outcome_name = "endometriosis",
  p_threshold = 5e-8
)

table(tobacco_to_endo$mr_keep)
attr(tobacco_to_endo, "log")

```

```{r clumping}
# Endometriosis → Tobacco 
endo_to_tobacco_clumped <- clump_mr(mr_dat = endo_to_tobacco) 
length(endo_to_tobacco_clumped$SNP)  #28

# Tobacco -> Endo 
tobacco_to_endo_clumped <- clump_mr(mr_dat = tobacco_to_endo) 
length(tobacco_to_endo_clumped$SNP)  #7
```
## Endometriosis to Tobacco Use MR

### Main MR and IVW Estimates
- MR egger near significant
- IVW not (based on 28)

```{r endo to toabcco MR}
Results_endo_to_tobacco <- run_mr_pipeline(
  clumped_dat = endo_to_tobacco_clumped,
  analysis_name = "Endometriosis → Tobacco (GWS)"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$mr),
  "markdown"
)

ivw <- subset(
  Results_endo_to_tobacco$mr,
  method == "Inverse variance weighted"
)

ivw$ci_lower <- ivw$b - 1.96 * ivw$se
ivw$ci_upper <- ivw$b + 1.96 * ivw$se

ivw[, c("b", "se", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "pval")]
```

### Heterogeneity, Pleiotropy and Egger

- no evidence of heterogenetiy or pleiotropy
- egger bootstrapping shows some sig snps

```{r Heterogeneity Test}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$heterogeneity),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$pleiotropy),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$leaveoneout_ivw),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$leaveoneout_egger),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_endo_to_tobacco$leaveoneout_egger_bootstrap),
  "markdown"
)
```

## Tobacco -> Endometriosis
### Main MR IVW Estimates
- on 7 genome-wide signifiacnt SNPs



```{r tobacco to endo MR}
Results_tobacco_to_endo <- run_mr_pipeline(
  clumped_dat = tobacco_to_endo_clumped,
  analysis_name = "Tobacco → Endo (GWS)"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$mr),
  "markdown"
)

ivw <- subset(
  Results_tobacco_to_endo$mr,
  method == "Inverse variance weighted"
)

ivw$ci_lower <- ivw$b - 1.96 * ivw$se
ivw$ci_upper <- ivw$b + 1.96 * ivw$se

ivw[, c("b", "se", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "pval")]
```

### Heterogeneity, Pleiotropy etc

```{r Heterogeneity Test}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$heterogeneity),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$pleiotropy),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_ivw),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_egger),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_egger_bootstrap),
  "markdown"
)
```

There is nominal evidence consistent with a positive causal effect, supported by directionally concordant weighted-median and leave-one-out results and no detected heterogeneity/pleiotropy, but the evidence remains limited by the small number of instruments and modest statistical significance.


## Tobacco --> Endometriosis (Relaxed for Tobacco)

```{r relaxed tobacco to endo harmonization}
tobacco_clump <- tobacco_qc
tobacco_clump$SNP <- tobacco_clump$rsID

endo_clump <- endo_qc
endo_clump$SNP <- endo_clump$rsID

source(paste0(filepath, "/scripts/mr_preprocessing.R"))

#tobacco to endo
tobacco_to_endo_relaxed <- harmonize_mr(
  exposure_dat = tobacco_clump,
  outcome_dat = endo_clump,
  exposure_name = "tobacco use",
  outcome_name = "endometriosis",
  p_threshold = 5e-7
)

table(tobacco_to_endo_relaxed$mr_keep)
attr(tobacco_to_endo_relaxed, "log")
```

```{r tobacco to endo relaxed clumping}
# Tobacco -> Endo  Relaxed
tobacco_to_endo_relaxed_clumped <- clump_mr(mr_dat = tobacco_to_endo_relaxed) 
length(tobacco_to_endo_relaxed_clumped$SNP)  #24
```

### Main MR Results (Tobacco to Endo Relaxed)

```{r tobacco to endo MR relaex}
Results_tobacco_to_endo <- run_mr_pipeline(
  clumped_dat = tobacco_to_endo_relaxed_clumped,
  analysis_name = "Tobacco → Endometriosis (GWS)"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$mr),
  "markdown"
)

ivw <- subset(
  Results_tobacco_to_endo$mr,
  method == "Inverse variance weighted"
)

ivw$ci_lower <- ivw$b - 1.96 * ivw$se
ivw$ci_upper <- ivw$b + 1.96 * ivw$se

ivw[, c("b", "se", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "pval")]
```
### Heterogeneity, Pleiotropy (relaxed)

```{r Heterogeneity Test}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$heterogeneity),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$pleiotropy),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_ivw),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_egger),
  "markdown"
)

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(Results_tobacco_to_endo$leaveoneout_egger_bootstrap),
  "markdown"
)
```

Given the increase in statistical power (with more instruments, but weaker), there is less convincing evidence of a causal effect in either direction, despite evidence of genetic overlap. 

# Endo and OUD

```{r reloading RDs OUD}
opioid_qc <- readRDS(paste0(outPath, "/opioid_qc.RData"))
```

```{r harmonization and preprocessing}

opioid_clump <- opioid_qc
opioid_clump$SNP <- opioid_clump$rsID

#endo to opioid
endo_to_opioid <- harmonize_mr(
  exposure_dat = endo_clump,
  outcome_dat = opioid_clump,
  exposure_name = "endometriosis",
  outcome_name = "opioid use",
  p_threshold = 5e-8
)

table(endo_to_opioid$mr_keep) 
attr(endo_to_opioid, "log")

#opioid to endo
opioid_to_endo <- harmonize_mr(
  exposure_dat = opioid_clump,
  outcome_dat = endo_clump,
  exposure_name = "opioid use",
  outcome_name = "endometriosis",
  p_threshold = 5e-7 #only 2 instruments otherwise (at gws)
)

table(opioid_to_endo$mr_keep)
attr(opioid_to_endo, "log")

```

```{r clumping endo and opioid}
# Endometriosis → Opioid 
endo_to_opioid_clumped <- clump_mr(mr_dat = endo_to_opioid) 
length(endo_to_opioid_clumped$SNP)  #20

# Opioid -> Endo (relaxed)
opioid_to_endo_clumped <- clump_mr(mr_dat = opioid_to_endo) 
length(opioid_to_endo_clumped$SNP)  #4
```

No significant bidirectional causal effects between endometriosis and opioid use disorder, or between tobacco and endometriosis.
